'''Gaoshan''' is an NPC in {{Location|Rearguard Base}}. He can be found between 18:00 to 06:00.

==Location==
{{Map Embed|Desorock Highland|Gaoshan}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Gaoshan:''' I find the wind extremely unsettling tonight... I sense a desperate voice from it.
:{{DIcon}} Who?
:'''Gaoshan:''' An old friend, who has been here for decades.
:'''Gaoshan:''' I can't leave him here for the lonely night. So I come here every night to keep his company.
:'''Gaoshan:''' If you happen to run into [[Zongye]] back in [[Jinzhou]] City, remember to say hi for me.
:'''Gaoshan:''' And remember to keep my secret.
{{Dialogue End}}
